settings.introHTML: This lesson teaches you how to talk about holiday plans in French. You will practise saying where you are going, what you are going to do, how you will travel, and what the weather is like.
settings.informationHTML:
After completing this unit, you will be able to:

  • Talk about holiday destinations, travel plans, transport, weather, and future activities.
  • Use the near future tense with aller + infinitive to describe plans, for example Je vais passer mes vacances en France.
  • Use aller to mean “to go”, to ask how someone is, and to form future intentions.
  • Use faire and il y a in common weather expressions such as Il fait chaud and Il y a du soleil.
  • Recognise useful holiday vocabulary for activities, transport, seasons, and francophone places.

phrases: Where are you going to spend your holidays?
Je vais passer mes vacances en France.
I'm going to spend my holidays in France.
À Bordeaux. C'est une très belle ville !
In Bordeaux. It's a very beautiful town.
phraseTable1.informationTextHTML: Read each line, then play the audio to hear how speakers ask where someone is going on holiday and name a destination in France.
Listen for the way the speakers ask about holiday plans, give a country, and then specify a French city.

phrases: Tu vas passer tes vacances en Europe cette année ?
Are you going to spend your holidays in Europe this year?
Non, je vais passer mes vacances dans les Caraïbes ! Je vais aller en Guadeloupe ! J'ai de la famille là-bas.
No, I'm going to spend my holidays in the Caribbean. I'm going to go to Guadeloupe. I've got family there.
Et qu'est-ce que tu vas faire là-bas ?
And what are you going to do there?

Il y a beaucoup de choses à faire. Je vais faire des randonnées. Je vais aller au Jardin botanique. Je vais voir les Chutes du Carbet. Et je vais bronzer sur la plage. Il fait très beau en Guadeloupe !

There's lots of things to do. I'm going to go hiking. I'm going to go the Botanic Garden. I'm going to see the Carbet Falls. And I'm going to sunbathe on the beach. The weather's very good in Guadeloupe!
Et toi, tu vas aller où ?
What about you? Where are you going to go?
Je ne vais pas partir en vacances cet été. Je vais rester chez moi pour écrire ma thèse !
I'm not going away on holiday this summer, I'm going to stay at home to write my dissertation.
phraseTable2.informationTextHTML: Read each line, then play the audio to hear how speakers describe holiday plans, activities, weather, and staying at home to work.
Notice how the speakers use the near future to describe travel plans, things to do in Guadeloupe, the weather, and staying at home to write.

vocabulary.informationTextHTML: This section introduces the key holiday, transport, beach, weather, and season vocabulary used throughout the lesson.

You will learn:

  • Holiday actions such as passer, loger, voyager, and partir.
  • Activity and place vocabulary such as bronzer, nager, faire du ski, faire du tourisme, and sur la plage.
  • Transport phrases such as en avion, en train, à vélo, à cheval, and à pied.
  • Weather and season expressions such as Quel temps fait-il ?, Il fait beau, Il y a du soleil, and en été.

instructionsLayout.paragraphHTML: This section explains weather expressions with faire and il y a, then shows how aller forms the near future for holiday plans.

grammar1.informationTextHTML: Focus on the French verbs used in weather phrases, because they do not translate word-for-word from English.

items.text: Il fait mauvais. [*The weather's bad.|It's sunny.|It's windy.|It's cold.|It's raining.|The weather's good.]
Il y a du soleil. [*It's sunny.|It's raining.|It's cold.|It's hot.|It's snowing.|The weather's bad.]
Il fait froid. [*It's cold.|It's hot.|It's snowing.|It's windy.|It's sunny.|The weather's good.]
Il pleut. [*It's raining.|It's windy.|The weather's good.|It's sunny.|It's snowing.|It's hot.]
Il fait chaud. [*It's hot.|It's cold.|The weather's bad.|It's raining.|It's windy.|It's snowing.]
Il neige. [*It's snowing.|It's sunny.|It's raining.|It's hot.|The weather's bad.|It's windy.]
Il fait beau. [*The weather's good.|It's windy.|It's cold.|It's raining.|It's snowing.|The weather's bad.]
Il y a du vent. [*It's windy.|It's hot.|It's snowing.|It's sunny.|It's cold.|The weather's good.]

dictationExercise1.informationTextHTML: Listen to each audio clip and write exactly what you hear. Use Check answers to review your entries, Show answers for support, and Reset to practise again.

items.text: Cette année, je vais [passer] mes vacances au Canada ! Je vais [revoir] ma famille !
Mes parents vont [être] très contents de me revoir. Ils vont [venir] me chercher à l'aéroport.
Pendant mes vacances, je vais [faire] du ski et du snow-rafting. J'adore la neige. Je vais [retrouver] mes amis et on va [sortir] ensemble. On va [dîner] au restaurant.
Je vais [aller] au Carnaval de Québec. Je vais bien [m'amuser] ! C'est sûr !
